ownerPrompt: Find 5 more x threads where people are building something similar to us and reply to them too, help them out, dont just sound like a guy promoting smth, even tho we sre doing it
authorization: Owner explicitly requested posting five additional useful replies to builders of related products or tooling.
timestampMeaning: Local receipt and verification times; not exact server publication timestamps.
independentPublicVisibility: Not established; verification uses the signed-in owner session.
selection: Five new thread parents and five previously uncontacted builder accounts in this campaign. Includes two AI visibility tools, a server-side request dashboard, a bot-analytics product team and an analytics integration-workflow author.
method: Read complete parent context before replying. Inspected Lumi GEO’s product page, LLMention’s linked full benchmark method, Thionne’s dashboard screenshot, Ahrefs’ collection-adapter release and Kolin’s full public setup gist including phases 9 and 13. A category search was narrowed through native X search and an unrelated account was excluded; no candidate URL grid was used.
copyDecision: Each reply starts with an actionable test, reporting change or storage check. Source link follows the useful detail. No generic endorsement, empty praise, reciprocal-engagement request or claim of a reproduced third-party defect.

limits: Recipient product behavior and reported benchmark/dashboard totals were not independently reproduced. Suggestions are proposed controls, not newly executed tests.
Kolin built the integration workflow; he is not represented as DataFast’s own developer.
No new provider trials, Cloudflare reads, referral measurement or response census. Existing measurement windows and article research footprint remain frozen.
No Reddit posts, manual votes/likes, follows, DMs, deletions, settings changes or monitoring.
Source links are canonical and untagged; posting receipts do not establish causal traction or per-reply blog visits.
